title: Current-state and v9 closure audit
objective: Audit current push in both repositories, map v9 requirements to implemented files/proofs, and identify incomplete gates.
scope: No code changes except audit artifacts.
proof: Evidence matrix, current commit refs, implemented/missing table, proof hygiene inventory.

title: Generic Components domain-leakage hardening
objective: Remove economy-shaped action vocabulary from WebGlRunLib public API or mark as deprecated and move to driver-owned extension.
proof: Source scan shows no economy/example terms in WebGlLib/WebGlRunLib public contracts except documented driver hooks.

title: Domain driver contract for run/visual mappings
objective: Introduce a formal domain-driver pattern so necessary domain vocabulary lives outside generic Components packages.
scope: Components generic abstractions + Economy driver implementation.
proof: Driver docs, sample no-op generic driver, Economy driver boundary tests.

title: Economy bridge migration to driver-owned visual flow action
objective: Move ResourceTransferVisual handling from generic action kinds to Economy driver mapping or generic DirectedValueFlow action.
proof: Existing scenarios still render; generic scan passes; deprecation notes if API retained temporarily.

title: Pause and immediate runtime stop proof v2
objective: Harden pause UX: immediate stop before C# drain, stale callback suppression, first-observable-stop assertion.
proof: Playwright proof asserts activeMotion=0, queuedMotion=0, queuedStage=0 immediately and after drain.

title: Settled runtime command lifecycle as hard contract
objective: Ensure applyCommandBatchAndWait and WebGlRunBrowserApplyAdapter distinguish scheduled/settled/cancelled/failed states.
proof: Unit + browser proof for scheduled vs settled; no false success while barriers/motions remain.

title: Browser observer proof must use exported runtime state
objective: Replace self-comparison/fallback observer proof with actual browser-exported scene/run state hashes and object positions.
scope: Components sandbox and WebGlRun observer contracts.
proof: Observer proof fails on deliberately mismatched document/hash; passes on actual runtime export.

title: Readiness evidence contract v3
objective: Make readiness bands artifact-derived: browser/UI/oracle flags computed from evidence bundle, not caller-provided booleans.
proof: ResearchReady cannot be true without artifact citations, hashes, oracle proof, and browser observer proof.

title: multi-goods-elite scenario canary hardening
objective: Promote third scenario into canary suite for exchange, multi-good holdings, capital claims, fee shocks, and concentration.
proof: Scenario passes catalog validation, headless strict, readiness, oracle, design matrix, and visual observer smoke.

title: Exchange/investment semantics driver
objective: Add generic economic simulation driver semantics for contribution, claim issue, return payment, obligations, and concentration measurement without hardcoding elite-specific behavior.
proof: Handlers are generic; scenario-specific names appear only in scenario packs/tests.

title: Golden oracle corpus expansion
objective: Externalize oracle cases and add multi-goods-elite oracle expectations including final stores, flows, claims, issues, metrics, frame hash chain.
proof: Oracle JSON corpus drives tests; broken expected value produces path-addressed diff.

title: Metamorphic and conservation properties
objective: Add property tests for conservation, monotonic fee effects, investment size effects, concentration bounds, and no hidden negative stores.
proof: Metamorphic failures classify as simulator bug vs model outcome.

title: Design matrix factor binding registry v2
objective: Extend factor materialization to capacity, policy parameter, event enable/disable, fee rate, investment size, return rate, relationship shock.
proof: Every factor declares binding; no-effect binding fails; effective pack hash changes.

title: Generic visualization canary for non-economy domains
objective: Add a non-economy sample/run document to Components to prove generic action lifecycle is not economy-shaped.
proof: Generic sample uses movement/pose/symbol/patch only and passes domain scan.

title: Proof integrity and CI gates
objective: Harden proof validator and CI workflows so empty transcripts, stale screenshots, and skipped scans fail the bundle.
proof: CI fails on empty critical proof; proof manifest must cite non-empty artifacts.

title: Performance and comparability budgets for third scenario
objective: Add headless and observer budgets for multi-goods-elite; classify not-comparable vs economic failure.
proof: Performance warnings do not mutate economic validity; headless hard budget failures mark not-comparable.

title: Docs/operator workflow: how to run credible experiments
objective: Update docs with exact workflow: exploratory, headless-valid, oracle-valid, browser-observer-valid, research-ready.
proof: Runbook includes CLI commands, expected artifacts, failure interpretation, and domain-driver guidance.

title: Final cross-repo red-team closure
objective: Independent QA pass over genericity, scenario trust, proof evidence, browser idle, and package boundaries.
scope: No feature work except fixes found by QA.
proof: Final report says what is safe to claim and what remains exploratory.
